name: 0.1-43-39684a6
notes: New Metal renderer: cartoon rocket with ink outlines, a real orange flame, 120 fps. Plays the same as before. Debug panel shows frame time and can switch back to the old renderer.

name: 0.1-33-11457fd
notes: Climb holds about 20° above horizontal and stages from there, no more going flat and pitching back up. Engine cut comes while still climbing.

name: 0.1-32-9c120a2
notes: The engine swings to your finger's command instead of jumping: up to 0.25 s from centre to full, small corrections immediate. Tunable in Tuning (Engine reaction time).

name: 0.1-31-456aa21
notes: Stage separates pitched up with a burst of venting gas and icy flecks. Autopilot pauses 1.5 s before each tap. Soundtrack no longer restarts mid-flight.

name: 0.1-29-c3ca0f5
notes: Smooth stage separation: the camera, outline, puff and flames now ease instead of popping. Includes the two-stage flight from build 28.
